amendment.outcomes_observed: Only failure of the eligibility gate; no primary endpoint was evaluated
amendment.prior_runs: primary, fresh-reproduction and failure-diagnosis retained under parent plan
amendment.reason: Diagnostic reporting repair after the original run raised the predeclared station-coverage gate. Return a structured inconclusive result instead of an exception. Same inputs, partitions, methods, thresholds and success rule; do not lower the gate or substitute stations.

parameters.novelty: Specific saved-ensemble calibration transfer check only; related predicted-flow calibration exists; no distribution-free coverage guarantee
parameters.primary_endpoint: Equal-station high-predicted-flow mean interval score versus global calibration; high flow uses fixed calibration 90th percentile only
parameters.success: At least 5% interval-score improvement, coverage within 0.05 of 0.90, and positive lower paired catchment-bootstrap limit

policy.result_selection: Retain every attempted row and failure; no tuning after observation
policy.variants: Only parameter variants explicitly enumerated here
